create_kbins_discretizer: create a KBinsDiscretizer to bin continuous data into intervals with uniform strategy
fit_kbins_discretizer: fit a KBinsDiscretizer on training data to compute bin edges and thresholds
transform_kbins_discretizer: transform continuous data into binned ordinal or one-hot encoded representation
inverse_transform_kbins: inverse transform binned data back to the original continuous feature space
get_feature_names_out: get output feature names from a fitted KBinsDiscretizer transformer
